en: Black‑and‑white historic street scene of a European town. A wide cobblestone street is flanked by two‑ and three‑storey buildings with shops on the ground floor and apartments above. Hanging shop signs and long horizontal fascia boards show German text. People in late‑19th or early‑20th‑century clothing walk along the pavement; a man stands by a doorway on the left, and several women and men are visible on the right. In the distance rises a tall church spire with ornate decoration and a cross on top. A wooden utility pole with a decorative streetlamp stands near the center of the image.
